hero.sub: Sekolah Bina Pandu Utama — an integrated SMP & SMA under Yayasan Pendidikan Bina Pandu Utama.

about.h2: An Institution Built on Trust and a Tradition of Excellence
about.p1: Founded in 1998, Sekolah Bina Pandu Utama has guided thousands of students through their educational journey. Under the Yayasan Pendidikan Bina Pandu Utama, we are committed to providing quality national education grounded in the values of faith, discipline, and academic excellence.
about.p2: With a continuously updated curriculum, certified teaching staff, and complete facilities, we stand as a trusted partner for families seeking the best future for their children.
about.principalTitle: Principal, SMP & SMA Bina Pandu Utama
about.visiText: To become a leading national educational institution that produces a generation of faith, character, and achievement, ready to face the challenges of the times.
about.misi1: Deliver quality national education guided by the values of faith and noble character.
about.misi2: Develop students' academic and non-academic potential in a balanced and sustained manner.
about.misi3: Build a disciplined, orderly, and characterful learning culture across the school environment.
about.misi4: Strengthen the partnership between school, family, and community in educating students.
about.misi5: Prepare graduates who are competitive at the higher-education level and in the world of work.

programs.h2: Two Levels, One Integrated Educational Journey
programs.smpDesc: Our junior high program is designed to build a strong academic foundation while shaping student character during their critical developmental years.
programs.smaDesc: Our senior high program prepares students for higher education and the workforce with two academic majors: Science (IPA) and Social Studies (IPS).
programs.note: Both levels are located within one integrated school environment, ensuring a continuous and well-supervised educational journey.

features.h2: Why Choose Sekolah Bina Pandu Utama?
features.1desc: Merdeka Curriculum combined with active and contextual learning approaches.
features.2desc: 84 nationally certified teachers with an average of 12 years of experience in their fields.
features.3desc: Science labs, library, hall, and computer lab with up-to-date equipment.
features.4desc: Over 150 awards at city, provincial, and national level since 2005.
features.5desc: Daily habits program, Islamic boarding school activities, and structured community service.
features.6desc: Active school committee, grade monitoring app, and regular parent-teacher meetings.

news.article1Title: SMA Bina Pandu Student Wins 1st Place at Provincial Chemistry Olympiad
news.article1Excerpt: Ahmad Rizky Pratama, a Grade 11 Science student, won first place at the 2025 West Java Chemistry Olympiad, competing against 234 participants from 67 schools.
news.article2Title: National Education Day 2025 Flag Ceremony Held with the Entire School Community
news.article2Excerpt: The entire Sekolah Bina Pandu Utama academic community participated in the flag ceremony commemorating the 66th National Education Day with reverence and enthusiasm.

admissions.step1Desc: Complete the online form or visit the school secretariat in person. Attach the required documents.
admissions.step2Desc: Academic ability test (Mathematics & Bahasa Indonesia) and motivational interview.
admissions.step3Desc: Selection results are announced via the school website and notice board.
admissions.step4Desc: Accepted students complete re-enrollment by submitting administration and payment.
admissions.quotaSma: SMA Quota: 144 Students (4 Science + 2 Social classes)
admissions.req4: Copy of last 2 semesters' report cards
